command_or_scenario_recipe: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GOOGLE_API_KEY=offline-test-placeholder .venv/bin/python -B -c 'import sys, runpy; import pydantic_ai.models as models; models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False; runpy.run_module(sys.argv[1], run_name="__main__")' tests.test_budget
expected: Permitted repair succeeds; shared exhaustion gives a bounded fixed fallback and no fresh unbudgeted request
actual: 9 checks passed. Exhaustion speaks one fixed line and makes no further model request (it previously made one, outside the spent budget). Requests are counted across agents in one turn; the request limit stops a turn that never hops; the tool limit is its own number; a slow tool hits the turn deadline; a legitimate two-attempt repair completes.
limitations: Offline and scripted. No real provider accepted these schemas, no audio was synthesised or recognised, and no carrier was involved. Nothing here transfers to a live call.
The budget numbers are proposals to tune, recorded in bench/baseline/budget.md. Nothing here shows they are the right numbers for a live call.
Disconnect mid-turn is not exercised: there is no transport in these tests.
